intro: Return to Rorian is a mission carrying urgent reports from the field back to Thendal Grove on Zephras Isle. After aiding Yala Windwatcher against encroaching forces, an adventurer is dispatched to inform Rorian the Dayseeker that the Al'Aketh cult has actively escalated their presence by disturbing the local wind spirits.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You've done enough here, adventurer. I'll stay and clean up any stragglers down there.
Head back to the Village and tell Rorian about the cult's presence. He will not be pleased.

clips.title: Completion
paras: This is most troubling, but unfortunately unsurprising. We've been aware of the cult's movements for some time, but we've been content to watch from afar. Their agitation of the wind spirits near the standing stones is a clear escalation on their part.
You've performed a difficult but necessary service for Thendal Grove, friend. Thank you.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
